description: Claude master asset manifest for the SirenVoxelLibrary catalog. A manifest entry is a plan, not a model: creation status is derived from files on disk by tools/claude/manifest.py.
sources: Sirens Went Quiet branch claude/practical-heisenberg-mjc1xx @ 32830df (items.gd, build_pieces.gd, prop_kit.gd, expedition_data.gd, experiment-003/ASSIGNMENT.md)

assets.name: Three-Seat Sofa
assets.brief: Slate-blue fabric three-seater on low wooden feet; sagging middle cushion, one seat cushion pushed askew, a folded blanket over one arm, armrest fronts rubbed darker.

assets.name: Armchair
assets.brief: Rust/terracotta upholstered armchair (the game's rust armchair) with a split seam on one arm, flattened seat cushion, faded headrest.

assets.name: Coffee Table
assets.brief: Low oak coffee table with a lower shelf holding a few magazines/newspapers; one corner chipped.

assets.name: Flat Television
assets.gameplay_use: Dead TV on a stand; living-room dressing
assets.brief: Unbranded ~43-inch flat TV on a centre foot, dark screen with a hairline crack across one corner, dust on top edge. No logo.

assets.name: TV Cabinet
assets.brief: Low walnut media cabinet: two doors and an open middle bay holding a set-top box and loose cables; one door off its top hinge.

assets.name: Bookshelf
assets.brief: Oak-veneer five-shelf bookcase, books in muted colours leaning and in gaps where some were taken, a small box and a framed photo.

assets.name: Side Table
assets.brief: Nearly new square side table with one drawer and a coaster; clean contrast to the worn pieces.

assets.name: Floor Lamp
assets.brief: Dark metal pole lamp on a weighted round base with a linen drum shade, shade slightly tilted; cord trailing.

assets.name: Small Storage Cabinet
assets.brief: Painted sage two-door cabinet, one door ajar, paint worn through around the handle, a shelf of folded towels visible.

assets.name: Living-Room Rug
assets.brief: Flat-woven rug with a simple border pattern in muted tones, one corner folded over, a scuffed walking path across it.

assets.name: Family Oak Dining Table
assets.brief: Reference model built by the lead: oak top with breadboard ends, apron, H-stretcher; edge wear.

assets.name: Dining Chair
assets.brief: Spindle-back chair that does NOT quite match the oak table: painted sage, paint worn off the seat front and back rail, one replaced darker spindle.

assets.name: Stool
assets.brief: Four-legged wooden kitchen stool with a footrest ring and a round-ish seat worn pale in the middle.

assets.name: Sideboard
assets.brief: Walnut sideboard with three drawers over two doors, one drawer pulled out, a bowl and a face-down picture frame on top.

assets.name: Small Shelf
assets.brief: Small free-standing open shelf (3 shelves) holding a few jars and stacked plates; slightly racked out of square.

assets.name: Single Bed
assets.brief: Covered by the pilot candidate.

assets.name: Double Bed
assets.brief: Wooden double bed with headboard, mauve bedding (game colour) pulled up hastily, two pillows, one side slept in.

assets.name: Nightstand
assets.brief: Drawer over an open shelf, an alarm clock and a paperback on top, drawer a little open.

assets.name: Wardrobe
assets.brief: Two-door wardrobe, one door ajar showing hanging clothes, a suitcase on top, kick marks at the base.

assets.name: Dresser
assets.gameplay_use: Chest of drawers; lootable; game prop 'dresser'
assets.brief: Chest of four drawers, the top drawer pulled out and emptied in a hurry, a sleeve hanging out of another.

assets.name: Small Desk
assets.brief: Simple desk with a drawer pedestal, a closed laptop and a mug; one drawer open.

assets.name: Desk Chair
assets.brief: Swivel office chair: five-star base with castors, padded seat with a torn edge, backrest tilted.

assets.name: Refrigerator
assets.brief: Old almond fridge-freezer, freezer above, a few magnets and a note, door seal hanging, rust bloom at the base.

assets.name: Stove / Oven
assets.brief: White enamel range with four burners and grates, oven door with a dark window and handle bar, knob row, backguard; grease stains.

assets.name: Kitchen Counter
assets.brief: 1 m base cabinet in the game's sage kitchen colour with a wood worktop, drawer over two doors, a toe kick; edges worn at the handles.

assets.name: Kitchen Sink
assets.brief: Matching 1 m sink base unit with a steel basin, swan-neck tap and a dish rack; a dry stain in the sink.

assets.name: Wall Cabinet
assets.brief: Sage wall cabinet, one door open showing plates and cups; wall-mount pivot documented.

assets.name: Pantry Shelf
assets.brief: Freestanding pantry shelving, mostly emptied: a few cans and jars, a split flour sack, an empty cardboard tray.

assets.name: Dining Crockery Set
assets.brief: Stack of plates with a bowl, a mug and a glass beside it on a folded tea towel (keeps the set one connected piece).

assets.name: Cooking Pot
assets.brief: Battered aluminium stockpot with lid and two side handles, dented, soot-black on the bottom.

assets.name: Frying Pan
assets.brief: Cast-iron skillet with a long handle, dark seasoned surface, slight rust on the rim.

assets.name: Kettle
assets.brief: Stovetop enamel kettle, cream with a dark handle and spout, chipped enamel, soot on the base.

assets.name: Wooden Cutting Board
assets.brief: Worn wooden board with knife marks, a hanging hole and a small paring knife on it.

assets.name: Toilet
assets.brief: Ceramic toilet, lid up, cistern with flush button, a faint stain line; plain and believable.

assets.name: Bathtub
assets.gameplay_use: Bathroom fixture; water storage; game prop 'bathtub'
assets.brief: Enamel built-in tub with front panel, tap at one end, partly filled with stored water (opaque water colour) - the survivors used it as a tank.

assets.name: Bathroom Sink
assets.brief: Vanity unit with ceramic basin and tap, cupboard doors, a toothbrush cup; one door hanging open.

assets.name: Medicine Cabinet
assets.brief: Wall-mounted mirrored cabinet with the door swung open, shelves rifled with two bottles left.

assets.name: Washing Machine
assets.brief: White front-loader with round porthole door, detergent drawer and dial; a sock caught in the seal.

assets.name: Clothes Dryer
assets.brief: Almond tumble dryer, visibly different from the washer: big flat door, vent hose out the back, lint and a dented side.

assets.name: Water Heater
assets.gameplay_use: Utility; emergency water source; game prop 'water_heater'
assets.brief: Cylindrical tank heater with pipes and valves on top, relief valve and drain valve, data plate, rust streak below the drain.

assets.name: Laundry Basket
assets.brief: Perforated plastic laundry basket with clothes heaped and a sleeve over the rim.

assets.name: Potted Plant
assets.brief: Neglected large-leaf house plant in a ceramic pot, half the leaves dried brown and fallen onto the floor.

assets.name: Cardboard Boxes
assets.brief: A stack of taped moving boxes, the top one opened and pulled through - signs of a hurried departure.

assets.name: Canned Food
assets.brief: Tall food tin with a muted paper label (simple colour blocks, no text), ribbed side, one small dent.

assets.name: Soup Can
assets.brief: Squat soup can with a red-and-cream label band and a ring-pull lid - reads differently from canned_food.

assets.name: Food Box
assets.brief: Cardboard cereal/cracker box with a muted printed panel, top flap open, a crease.

assets.name: Snack Package
assets.brief: Pillow-shaped crinkled snack bag with crimped ends and a plain colour panel.

assets.name: Water Bottle
assets.brief: 1.5 L plastic bottle in pale blue-grey (opaque stylisation), cap, ribbed waist, plain label band.

assets.name: Large Water Container
assets.brief: 20 L stackable blue plastic water container with moulded handle and a spigot cap.

assets.name: Food Storage Crate
assets.brief: Ventilated plastic stacking crate holding cans and jars, lid leaning against it.

assets.name: Small Cooler
assets.brief: Picnic cooler with faded teal body, pale lid and swing handle, scuffed corners.

assets.name: Workbench
assets.brief: Covered by the pilot candidate.

assets.name: Wooden Storage Crate
assets.brief: Player-built crate of mismatched scavenged boards with a hinged lid and rope handles; nail heads visible.

assets.name: Metal Storage Cabinet
assets.brief: Grey steel two-door cabinet, one door dented, padlock hasp, louvres, scratches at the handle.

assets.name: Tool Chest
assets.brief: Rolling mechanic's tool chest in dusty red, stacked drawers with one open, casters, side handle.

assets.name: Toolbox
assets.brief: Blue-grey steel cantilever toolbox with the trays opened, a few tool handles visible (distinct from the red box on the pilot workbench).

assets.name: Rainwater Collector
assets.gameplay_use: Build piece 'Rain collector' (+1 water each dawn)
assets.brief: Covered by the pilot candidate.

assets.name: Wood-Burning Stove
assets.brief: Covered by the pilot candidate.

assets.name: Improvised Forge

assets.name: Water Barrel
assets.brief: 200 L blue-grey plastic drum on two cinder blocks with screw bungs and a retrofitted brass tap.

assets.name: Basic Generator
assets.brief: Open-frame portable generator: tube frame, fuel tank on top, engine block, outlet panel, pull-start.

assets.name: Camping Stove
assets.brief: Two-burner suitcase camping stove, lid up as windshield, hose to a small gas cylinder.

assets.name: Plank Bundle

assets.name: Scrap Metal Pile

assets.name: Claw Hammer

assets.name: Crowbar
assets.brief: Hex-bar crowbar with a curved claw end and chipped dusty-red paint.

assets.name: Hatchet
assets.brief: Hatchet with tape-wrapped wooden handle and a rust-flecked steel head.

assets.name: Shovel
assets.brief: Round-point shovel with a wooden shaft and D-grip, dried dirt on the blade.

assets.name: Pickaxe
assets.brief: Pickaxe with a long wooden haft and a pointed/chisel head.

assets.name: Hand Saw
assets.brief: Hand saw with a wooden D-handle and a tapering blade.

assets.name: Flashlight

assets.name: Nail Tin

assets.name: Battery Lantern

assets.name: Candle

assets.name: Jerry Can

assets.name: Fuel Container

assets.name: Portable Battery

assets.name: Wall First-Aid Box

assets.name: Backpack
